name: Temple Sanctum
description: The approach to a temple, through its doors, into the sanctum, and down onto a lit mandala on the floor — which is where the statue stands. No deity appears in it.

provenance.notes: Re-encoded from footage supplied with the project as entry_vid.MP4: the opening title segment (which carried a wordmark that is not this product's) is cut through the end of its fade, verified frame-by-frame; the generator's corner glyph is removed in-frame, and the audio track is dropped. No third-party branding survives in the pixels.
